rv.q: Larger Than Life is a triumph of nostalgic storytelling and modern projection technology.
Despite its familiar archive material, the show's all-encompassing presentation makes even the most recognisable moments from Aardman's body of work feel fresh, immersive and alive.
Ensuring there is something for everyone to be found at this cracking experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive celebration of Aardman's 50th anniversary as a spectacular, high-quality experience that showcases beloved British animations on a grand scale at Lightroom's impressive 360-degree venue.
